name: seis-sbom-generator
description: Generate an in-memory local SBOM projection from bounded manifests without writing artifacts.

interface.shortDescription: Project a redacted in-memory SBOM from local manifests.
interface.longDescription: Reads bounded package manifests and lockfiles and returns a deterministic in-memory inventory. It does not write an SBOM, query registries or certify completeness.
interface.defaultPrompt: Generate a redacted in-memory SBOM projection for this local repository.
